message.content: {"verdict":"revise","score":0.43,"reasons":["Missing prioritized blockers section with impact severity and rough time-to-resolution ranges.","Patent filings count by major players is not present; section is required by the brief.","No explicit 'methods' note; only scattered notes; add a dedicated methods/confidence section.","Conflicts are not highlighted; e.g., ProLogium energy density claims of 321 Wh/kg vs 381 Wh/kg differ by source/date.","Some data is inconsistently labeled or incomplete (Tables A-C include 'not reported' for many fields; ensure consistent data provenance citation).","Timeline presents independent analyst projections as notes but lacks a dedicated, clearly sourced projections section; harmonize timeline with vendor milestones and analyst views.","Formatting requires a clear, explicit file structure and data provenance; ensure the artifact is saved as analysis_report.md with distinct sections and a concise data gaps note."],"guidance":"Add the missing sections and tighten the data presentation: 1) Add Section 3: Blockers (technical/commercial) with severity (1-5) and rough time-to-resolution (years). 2) Add Section 4: Patent filings counts by major players (and note where data is absent). 3) Add Section 5: Methods and Confidence note: state data sources (raw_findings.md only), assumptions, confidence levels per table. 4) Add Section 6: Conflicts/discrepancies: flag conflicting claims (e.g., ProLogium 321 Wh/kg vs 381 Wh/kg). 5) Update Timeline section to clearly separate vendor milestones (M) and independent projections (if any) with sources; annotate uncertainties. 6) Ensure all tables have consistent units, clearly cite sources, and mark 'not reported' explicitly. 7) Provide a concise Data Gaps/Next Steps subsection and ensure the file is saved as analysis_report.md."}
